description: This file is a plugin module for the Trumbowyg WYSIWYG editor, adding Giphy GIF insertion functionality with multilingual support and dynamic GIF search modal.

methods.name: trumbowygThrottle
methods.description: Creates a throttled version of a callback function to limit its execution rate.

methods.name: renderGifs
methods.description: Renders GIFs in the modal based on API response, handling image loading, click events for inserting images, and fallback for no results.
